title: Right-Wing Strategic Litigation in Times of Culture Wars Before the ECtHR
brief_summary: How conservative and religious groups are using the European Court of Human Rights to push back against gender equality, LGBTI+ rights, and other progressive norms — and why this makes the Court a contested arena rather than a neutral one.

title: The Constitutional Role of Municipalities in the Governance of Social Rights: A Comparative Study of Turin, Barcelona, and Athens
brief_summary: A comparative study of Barcelona, Turin, and Athens on how cities handle the rights to education, health, and housing — finding that local innovation matters, but cannot substitute for clear legal powers and stable financing.
